value.rationale: The whole negative-lift band is a nonarbitrary invariant set bounded by natural zero-rotation circles that collide at epsilon=1, a parameter highlighted in the original map literature. The conditional Liouville phase-volume law quantifies the fraction of invariant circles exceeding every reverse-frequency threshold, its strict two-sided order gives an entire-parameter monotonic phase diagram, and the beta limit plus separate area/maximum/flux exponents are sharp analytic benchmarks for shearless-transport simulations. No claim is made for chaotic transport or the nonintegrable band.
